The '''CC-series capital ship''' described several ship models related to the [[DP20 gunship/Legends|Corellian gunship]] series.

==History==
Notable models included the [[Detainer CC-2200/Legends|Detainer CC-twenty-two-hundred]], the [[CC-7700 frigate/Legends|CC-7700 frigate]], the [[CC-7700/E interdiction cruiser|CC-7700/E]], and the [[CC-9600 frigate]].
